description: Agent Delegation: submit a delegation chain as supplied: the principal at the top, the work it serves, whether the whole chain is kept as one record, and each hop in order with who delegates to whom, the tasks, spending ceiling, tools, data and end passed on, and whether the principal can see that hop. The signed report lays the hops end to end, says hop by hop whether the scope narrowed, held or grew against the hop above, whether the scope narrowed overall and whether the chain’s full length is visible to the principal, and names every hop that passes on tasks, tools or data the hop above lacks, a higher ceiling or a later end, and every hop that drops a bound the hop above states, then every hop out of the principal’s sight, every hop that does not link to the one above, a first hop that does not start from the principal and a chain kept in no one record, with the fix for each. This reads authority as it passes down a chain of delegations: who held one task at each step is wever_chain-of-custody-check, approver bands are wever_approval-chain-check and one handoff’s grant against what its task needs is wever_handoff-scope-check. A summary sample is wever_delegation-chain-sample on https://weverlabs.com/mcp-free. Verdict authority_grew, chain_gaps, chain_unverified or authority_narrowed. POST /api/delegation-chain-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-delegation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-delegation/.

hops.description: Each hop in order, from the principal down.

data.description: The data passed on at this hop.

ends_at.description: When the authority passed on at this hop ends, such as 2026-12-31.

from.description: Who delegates at this hop, such as the finance director.

principal_sees.description: The principal at the top can see this hop in a record or view they read.

spend.description: The spending ceiling passed on at this hop, such as 500 USDC, or unlimited.

tasks.description: The tasks passed on at this hop.

to.description: Who receives the authority at this hop, such as the payments agent.

tools.description: The tools passed on at this hop.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

principal.description: Who stands at the top of the chain, such as the finance director.

recorded.description: The whole chain is kept as one record the principal reads, not pieced together from separate logs.

task.description: The work the chain serves, such as vendor payments.

name: wever_delegation-chain-check
title: Delegation chain check
